question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Administer
solution:
The correct answer is: **Forego**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Administer **means to manage or supervise. (प्रबंधन या पर्यवेक्षण करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The doctor will administer the vaccine to protect against the flu.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Forego **is the opposite of 'administer' and means to give up or abstain from. (त्यागना)
 
 
• **Example**: *She decided to forego dessert to stick to her diet plan.*
 
 

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Steady **means consistent or stable. (सुसंगत या स्थिर)
 
• **Entertaining **means enjoyable or amusing. (आनंददायक या मनोरंजक)
 
• **Pictural **is not a valid English word.
